dublinCore.dc:title: 116 HR 205 RH: Protecting and Securing Florida’s Coastline Act of 2019
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Rooney of Florida (for himself and Ms. Castor of Florida) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Natural Resources

Additional sponsors: Mr. Buchanan, Mr. Gaetz, Mr. Diaz-Balart, Mr. Rutherford, Mr. Bilirakis, Mr. Dunn, Mr. Posey, Mr. Gallagher, Mr. Cunningham, Mr. Mast, Mr. Soto, Mr. Crist, Mr. Hastings, Mr. Harder of California, Ms. Lee of California, Mr. Cartwright, and Mr. Himes
Committed to the Committee of the Whole House on the State of the Union and ordered to be printed

form.official-title: To amend the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 to permanently extend the moratorium on leasing in certain areas of the Gulf of Mexico.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protecting and Securing Florida’s Coastline Act of 2019.

section.header: Permanent extension of moratorium on leasing in certain areas of the Gulf of Mexico
section.text: Section 104(a) of the Gulf of Mexico Energy Security Act of 2006 (43 U.S.C. 1331 note) is amended by striking Effective during and all that follows through the Secretary and inserting The Secretary.

endorsement.action-desc: Committed to the Committee of the Whole House on the State of the Union and ordered to be printed
